column1: # mrk-picker's package descriptions. mrk-picker embeds this file when it is built.
# One line for each name a Brewfile `brew` or `cask` line uses: the name, a tab,
# and the description. A formula and a cask with the same name share one line.
# Lines are in byte order of the name, as `LC_ALL=C sort` puts them. A line that
# starts with # is a comment, and a blank line is ignored.
# check-picker-desc holds this file to the Brewfile. sync and
# `check-picker-desc --fix` add and delete lines here; write a description by
# hand in the same shape, and they keep it.
